title: dispatch-gates: the diff-scope `check-issue-citations` run is reported NOT MEASURED (workflow-valued), and `pnpm check:issue-citations` is only its self-test, so a dev's local gate sweep passes a PR that CI then reds
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, the family derivation for `scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs`. It is PM-loop tooling, so it belongs to the skills lane by the lane table (non-gate `scripts/pm/**`). Grading reasoning (NORTH-STAR 〈仪器为车队服务〉): it caused a landing that could not go through, measured below.

Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 2 (`session_01QcAS3qiYYZNezaxZxaUdMV`, seat post #18549), from the #19967 dev's CI-fix round (PR #20268, `out_of_scope_findings[1]`). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happened (measured)

- The #19967 dev ran every family `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived and reconciled with `--ran`: 112 run, 4 NOT MEASURED. It reported the issue-citation family green, because `pnpm check:issue-citations` is `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs --self-test` (`package.json:83`), which never judges the diff.
- The diff-scope run, bare `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs`, is what `lint.yml` runs as step "Issue citations this change adds resolve on the board". Dispatch-gates lists it as a workflow-valued family and marks it NOT MEASURED.
- CI then went red on PR #20268 (job `108670048521`): `[allocated-but-absent] packages/spec/src/security/rls.zod.ts:425 #16608`. That cost one dev round and one fresh at-tier review before the PR could land.

## Why it matters

The dispatch order tells every dev to run the derived families locally and to keep NOT MEASURED to true prerequisite refusals. This family has no prerequisite: it needs only network for the board probe, which a dev container has. So "left to CI" is a silent hole in exactly the gate that the tracker-number rules (ruling C+D on #19123) lean on.

## Suggested shape (⛔ not a ruling)

Derive the diff-scope command, `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs` (optionally with its base flag), as a runnable family beside the self-test. Or rename the npm script so the self-test is not mistaken for the gate. Pin the derivation in dispatch-gates' self-test.

Dedupe: open issues filtered locally for `issue-citations` together with `dispatch-gates` → 0 hits.
